bastoni-01.exo: Creative force in its nascent state: a fresh surge, an idea that ignites, an initiative that starts with vigour. It announces energy, enthusiasm, the desire to act and to generate.
bastoni-01.psy: The spark of will before it has chosen a direction; pure vitality that asks for a channel to express itself and, if ignored, turns into restlessness.
bastoni-01.ini: The Ace in Kether: the root of Fire and the seed of the Yod of the Tetragrammaton. It is not yet an event but the power that makes one possible; its throne is the celestial quadrant of Cancer, Leo and Virgo, governed by the Princess of Wands.
bastoni-01.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals a flash in the pan, impulsiveness, energy that burns without building anything.
bastoni-01.up: A strong creative push is available now: act while the flame is alive. An excellent moment to begin, propose and dare.
bastoni-01.rev: Energy that is blocked or scattered, enthusiasm that never becomes action; or impetuosity that burns opportunities before they ripen.
bastoni-01.love: Ardent attraction, a new interest, passion that arises suddenly.
bastoni-01.work: A new project, an entrepreneurial initiative, creative momentum to be channelled at once.
bastoni-01.spirit: The awakening of life force as the first spark of the True Will.
bastoni-01.crowley: Crowley paints a great primordial torch from which ten flames in the shape of Yods blaze, arranged like the sephiroth of the Tree: Fire as a natural force not yet disciplined.

bastoni-02.exo: Personal power, courage, the ability to assert yourself and to lead. It points to ambitious projects and the strength to carry them out, with a possible streak of hardness.
bastoni-02.psy: Will in its purest and most combative form: the confidence that you can bend circumstances. It asks you to tell strength apart from overbearing force.
bastoni-02.ini: Fire in Chokmah, Wisdom as dynamic energy, with Mars in his own house of Aries in the first decan: fire at its most ardent and virile. Dominion is the will asserting itself before any form, pure directive power.
bastoni-02.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals obstinacy, bullying, violence, strength squandered in pointless battles.
bastoni-02.up: You have the power to steer the situation: take the initiative with determination and a clear vision.
bastoni-02.rev: Strength without direction, or frustrated; power conflicts, impatience, held-back aggression looking for an outlet.
bastoni-02.love: Dominant passion and a desire to conquer; take care not to overpower the other person.
bastoni-02.work: Leadership, initiative, bold projects; a position of command to be managed with balance.
bastoni-02.spirit: Learning to direct your own force instead of being directed by it.
bastoni-02.crowley: In the Thoth deck two crossed Tibetan dorjes, thunderbolts of the will, discharge flames and end in serpent heads: the power to destroy in order to create.

bastoni-03.exo: First concrete results, integrity, self-confidence. It points to an enterprise well begun, supported by clear values and steady energy.
bastoni-03.psy: Strength finds a form and recognises itself: a sense of dignity and inner coherence is born that needs no outside confirmation.
bastoni-03.ini: Fire in Binah, the Mother who gives form, with the Sun exalted in Aries in the second decan: will becomes character. Virtue is force established, the fire that has found its vessel and begins to illuminate.
bastoni-03.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals pride, arrogance, the presumption of always being in the right.
bastoni-03.up: Your actions are consistent with your values: the road is right, so go on with confidence and openness.
bastoni-03.rev: Doubts about your own integrity, or success that goes unrecognised; or a haughtiness that isolates.
bastoni-03.love: A relationship founded on mutual esteem and a shared project.
bastoni-03.work: First tangible results, recognition, collaborations that start off on the right foot.
bastoni-03.spirit: Virtue as coherence between will, word and action.
bastoni-03.crowley: Three wands ending in lotus flowers that open onto a dawn light: the spring of energy, fire in bloom.

bastoni-04.exo: Work accomplished, harmony, celebration, stability reached. It points to feasts, milestones, and solid homes and relationships.
bastoni-04.psy: The satisfaction of someone who has concluded a cycle and can enjoy it without losing vitality; the pleasure of feeling in your rightful place.
bastoni-04.ini: Fire in Chesed, Mercy that organises, with Venus in Aries in the third decan: Venusian sweetness tempers Martial impetus. Completion is energy becoming order and benevolent rule.
bastoni-04.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals complacency, stasis, loss of momentum, premature conclusions.
bastoni-04.up: A goal is reached: celebrate and consolidate what you have built before setting off again.
bastoni-04.rev: Success that is unstable or not enjoyed; an anxiety to move on, postponed celebrations, foundations that need reinforcing.
bastoni-04.love: A stable union, living together, engagements or celebrations.
bastoni-04.work: A completed project, closed contracts, a harmonious working environment.
bastoni-04.spirit: The peace that follows work accomplished, to be lived as a base and not as an end.
bastoni-04.crowley: In the Thoth deck the four wands end in ram's heads and doves, symbols of Mars and Venus, arranged in a wheel: strength and love joined in a perfect circle.

bastoni-05.exo: Conflicts, rivalries, difficulties that demand effort. It points to struggles, disputes and obstacles, but also to the strength needed to overcome them.
bastoni-05.psy: Tension between the wish to expand and the limits imposed; a frustration that can become a stimulus if it does not degenerate into resentment.
bastoni-05.ini: Fire in Geburah, Severity, with Saturn in Leo in the first decan: Saturnine weight pressed onto solar energy. Strife is fire wrestling with form, the will meeting the resistance of matter.
bastoni-05.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals aggression, sterile quarrels, cruelty, energy wasted in contrasts.
bastoni-05.up: The situation is conflictual: face the challenge openly and loyally, turning tension into strength.
bastoni-05.rev: Suppressed conflict that wears you down from within; or a quarrel that degenerates beyond what is needed.
bastoni-05.love: Arguments, tensions, jealousies; confrontation can clarify things if it stays loyal.
bastoni-05.work: Competition, fierce rivals, bureaucratic or hierarchical obstacles.
bastoni-05.spirit: Conflict as a forge in which the will is tempered.
bastoni-05.crowley: The wand of the Chief Adept, crowned by the winged globe, dominates and crosses those of the lesser adepts with phoenix and lotus: energy fights against the gravity of Saturn.

bastoni-06.exo: Victory, success, public recognition. It points to obstacles overcome, good news and the respect of others.
bastoni-06.psy: Energy returns to balance after the struggle: self-confidence is born from a test passed and not from presumption, and can therefore afford to be generous.
bastoni-06.ini: Fire in Tiphareth, the harmonious heart of the Tree, with Jupiter in Leo in the second decan: beneficent expansion supports solar strength. Victory is balanced energy that wins without destroying.
bastoni-06.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals arrogance, fleeting victory, a need for approval.
bastoni-06.up: Success is within reach or already achieved: welcome it with generosity and share it.
bastoni-06.rev: Victory delayed or little recognised; or triumphalism that drives allies away.
bastoni-06.love: A relationship that overcomes a crisis, an emotional conquest, mutual pride.
bastoni-06.work: Promotions, recognition, negotiations won, leadership that is appreciated.
bastoni-06.spirit: The inner victory: the will aligned with the heart.
bastoni-06.crowley: In the Thoth deck the adepts' wands cross in orderly fashion, with nine flames burning steadily: disciplined energy wins without violence.

bastoni-07.exo: Courage, determination, resistance in the face of opposition. It points to battles fought with valour, even against superior forces, and to victories that are possible but not guaranteed.
bastoni-07.psy: The courage that emerges when structures are no longer enough and only personal trust remains; the individual's fighting energy, which must however avoid seeing enemies everywhere.
bastoni-07.ini: Fire in Netzach, emotional but unstable Victory, with Mars in Leo in the third decan: energy falls below the balance of Tiphareth and loses coordination. Valour is the individual courage that makes up for lost order: you can win, but only with the heart.
bastoni-07.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals stubbornness, hostility, battles lost for lack of strategy.
bastoni-07.up: Defend your position with courage: victory is possible but calls for personal commitment.
bastoni-07.rev: Weariness in the fight, doubt about your own strength; or excessive combativeness.
bastoni-07.love: Defending the bond from interference or doubts; do not turn every discussion into a battle.
bastoni-07.work: Competition, defending positions, against-the-grain initiatives carried through with grit.
bastoni-07.spirit: Courage as a spiritual virtue: staying true to yourself even without support.
bastoni-07.crowley: Crowley sets a rough, unhewn staff before the six ordered wands: individual valour taking the place of collective discipline.
